title: YANG and NETCONF: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Every device needs a blueprint for how it's configured. A shared blueprint lets tools talk to any device. That blueprint is called YANG.

scenes.heading: Building blueprints
scenes.narration: Three names get mixed up all the time. YANG is the data model, the blueprint itself. NETCONF delivers it, using X M L. RESTCONF delivers it too, using X M L or J S O N. Models starting with I E T F are standard.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It's a model, not a protocol. It models state too. It can use X M L or J S O N.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. YANG is the blueprint. NETCONF and RESTCONF carry it. It covers config and state. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva YANG lab.
